faq.q: What is the origin of Emel?
faq.a: Emel is associated with Arabic. Emel is the Turkish form of Arabic أَمَل (Amal), meaning 'hope'.
Yes — the underlying form أَمَل is Arabic.
Emel can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
